answer: Because selection is random and the lagoon seed is unrevealed until close, an attacker cannot dodge the sample, so colluding to grade clones' junk is a grove gamble with a negative expected value. The cipher log keeps the sampled set and the penalty so the deterrent is verifiable. A random sample of settled verdicts is re-graded by an independent panel each epoch, and a divergence found on re-check costs the original grader 10% of its standing plus a seat ban.
